text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2103456789 — eu-west GPU pool reported 100% allocation, autoscaler throttled, error rate spike (50% 5xx for inference API). Paging oncall.

maya: taking this, joining bridge. starting quick triage: is this autoscaler policy misfiring or genuine capacity shortage?

sanjay: i'm oncall — confirming it's a capacity shortfall; cluster shows node drain events and preemptions in eu-west-1a. thin-provision buffer exhausted.

olivia: possible warm-up failure from recent kernel upgrade in eu-west. noticed higher OOM logs. linking logs: https://logs.example/redwood/2103456789

ben: mitigation steps i can do now:
1) temporarily increase reserved-gpu pool by 3 nodes (manual) to buy time
2) enable regional fallthrough to eu-central for non-SLA traffic
3) scale down heavy batch jobs and evict non-critical pods

maya: sanjay, can you run the scale command? i'll open a fallback route.

sanjay: running now:
```
# scale reserved pool
kubectl -n infra scale --replicas=3 deploy/reserved-gpu-eu-west
# cordon problematic nodes
kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-47
```

sanjay: nodes coming up, pods scheduling, error rate dropping to ~12%.

priya: posting customer impact note — key customers A & B saw 429s for 8-12 mins. drafting notif to status page. @olivia please confirm wording.

olivia: ack, keep it blunt but not panicked. proposed text:
"We experienced elevated inference errors in eu-west due to GPU node preemptions. Traffic was routed to fallback region and most requests recovered within 15 minutes. We're investigating root cause and will share a post-incident report."

priya: :white_check_mark: posting now.

ben: root cause hypothesis: spot preemption cascade plus autoscaler cooldown too aggressive. proposed action items:
- adjust autoscaler cool-down and preemption handling (owner: infra-sre)
- add proactive node warmers for reserved pool (owner: maya)
- set up cross-region spillover runbook and test matrix (owner: product)

infra-sre: capturing items. i'll create a short runbook PR and tweak the cluster autoscaler config. snippet of alert i want to add:
```
alert: GPUPoolPressure
expr: sum(gpu_allocated) / sum(gpu_capacity) > 0.9 for 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

maya: let's schedule a postmortem sync tomorrow. i'm free 13:00-14:00 UTC. how about 13:30?

olivia: 13:30 works. creating calendar invite. :calendar:

ben: i'll open Jira epic RED-2103 and add the three action items, link PRs and owners. i'll post back with ticket numbers.

sanjay: thanks everyone. monitoring for the next hour. leaving channel open for any late regressions.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting created: https://calendar.example/event/pm-2103456789 — participants: maya, sanjay, olivia, ben, priya, infra-sre

priya: assign comms follow-up to me — i'll send a short post-incident status to impacted customers once we have the RCA draft.

maya: closing this thread for live mitigation. all action items assigned in Jira will be followed up in the postmortem. :lock:
